fire: The economist Henry George argued that land values should bear the main burden of taxation.
In 1793 the explorer Alexander Mackenzie reached the Pacific coast overland.
The televangelist Benny Hinn drew large crowds to his healing crusades.
The Ming admiral Cheng Ho led several great treasure voyages across the Indian Ocean.
Admiral Horatio Nelson was killed at the Battle of Trafalgar in 1805.
The evangelist Billy Graham preached to millions in stadiums around the world.
Ivan Sutherland built Sketchpad, one of the first graphical user interfaces.
Plumes of water vapor shoot out from the south pole of Saturn's moon Enceladus.
quiet: The economist John Maynard Keynes argued that governments should spend during recessions.
In 1793 the explorer reached the Pacific coast overland after months of hard travel.
Prime Minister Lloyd George led Britain through the last years of the war.
The singer Boy George became famous with Culture Club in the 1980s.
A girl called Mackenzie won the school spelling bee this spring.
Abraham Lincoln was shot at Ford's Theatre in 1865.
Alan Turing built early ideas about computing machines and artificial intelligence.
A thick orange haze covers the surface of Saturn's moon Titan.
